work_unit.title: 补齐 Channel Connector webhook OpenAPI 契约
work_unit.goal: Register the public connection-bound Channel Connector V1 callback in the OpenAPI source of truth without misrepresenting its provider-authenticated boundary.

invariants: The route remains public at the HTTP boundary because the connector worker authenticates the exact raw provider request.
All plugin, connector, Workspace and connection path parameters are represented.
No raw provider payload, headers or credential values are persisted by this contract change.

tdd_plan.red: Use the failing exact mounted-route coverage assertion from the full suite.
tdd_plan.green: Add the single missing OpenAPI path registration with opaque provider request body and accurate response codes.
tdd_plan.refactor: Keep the registration adjacent to the existing generic plugin webhook contract.

stop_conditions: The contract introduces board or agent authentication for the public callback.
The change requires runtime route behavior changes.
